framework: Eleven-stage 240-second edit allocation: 7, 6, 15, 75, 45, 40, 10, 10, 15, 10, 7 seconds. Stage S10 uses a practical next step rather than unsupported scarcity. These are edit targets, not measured take durations.

blocks.title: Time for you
blocks.spoken: Want time for you? Come learn a new skill with us.
blocks.overlay: Time for you. Room to learn.
blocks.picture: Sandy speaks to camera; cut to an adult arrival only with permission.

blocks.title: Calm coaching
blocks.spoken: I coach you step by step. We start calm.
blocks.picture: Sandy shows one move with a consenting adult partner.

blocks.title: See how coaching works
blocks.spoken: See how I coach. I show a move. You try it with a partner. I watch and give you a clear tip. You try the move.
blocks.overlay: See a move. Try it. Get a tip.
blocks.picture: Capture one connected coach cue, learner attempt, feedback, and retry. If that clip is missing, keep Sandy on camera; add proof footage after permission review.

blocks.title: Why learn with Sandy?
blocks.spoken: I am Sandy. I earned my black belt at Clockwork Jiu Jitsu in New York City. I taught kids there. I led adult classes in Brooklyn. I coach in Tannersville. We start by talking about your goals. You can tell me what you want to learn. We see the room and talk about the rules. I help you plan your first class. We find a pace and partner that fit you. You can ask me questions as we go. You get a clear next step. Come meet me and see how we train in the Catskills.
blocks.picture: Use Sandy to camera and a permission-cleared lineage image. Use real coaching rather than invented biography or outcomes.

blocks.title: How do we start?
blocks.spoken: You start in our Beginner Lane. I show you the room. We talk through the rules. You learn with a matched partner at your pace. You can ask me to show a move. We try it one step at a time. You can pause a round. I help you find your next step. You get time to learn how class feels.
blocks.picture: Show the room tour and coached adult practice with matched pace. Avoid edited demonstrations that imply physical effort is unnecessary.

blocks.title: How does my first class work?
blocks.spoken: We plan a first class that fits you. Adults start with a visit. You can ask to train that day. I must confirm your class before you train. You can choose a later day. Kids and teens use their own class plan. A parent or guardian stays with them. I confirm the class and what to wear. We talk about your goals and find the next step together. Wear day clothes to visit. Wear clean sports clothes to train.
blocks.picture: Keep Sandy on camera during the adult and youth distinction. Show adults only unless youth media permissions are documented.

blocks.title: What is the first step?
blocks.spoken: Meet me for fifteen minutes. See the room. I confirm your free first class.
blocks.overlay: Meet Sandy. Plan your free class.
blocks.picture: Show a goal chat and room tour; do not cut straight from arrival to training as if confirmation were automatic.

blocks.title: What happens after the visit?
blocks.spoken: You can ask questions. You choose your next step. I can help you plan a later class.
blocks.picture: Sandy speaks to camera; an optional consenting adult greeting illustrates welcome rather than a guaranteed outcome.

blocks.title: What comes after the free class?
blocks.spoken: Your first class is free. If you choose to keep training, I show you the paid plans. You can ask me what each plan includes.
blocks.overlay: First class free. You choose what comes next.
blocks.picture: Sandy explains the choice; omit prices and student counts from graphics.

blocks.title: Find a time that fits
blocks.spoken: Pick a visit time that fits your week. We can talk about your goals and plan your class.
blocks.picture: Show the current booking page without personal data. Do not add spot counters or full-class graphics.

blocks.title: Reserve your first visit
blocks.spoken: Tap the link for your free visit. Come meet me.
blocks.picture: Hold a readable first-visit link or button. Keep booking access visible.
